convention: UTC dates from daily timestamps. Last actual trading close per calendar month; endpoints include 12 trailing months and cutoff plus60 holding months. Dividends use vendor ex-dates and backward-adjusted amounts, which need not equal original cash payments. Splits use vendor first trading dates; issuer record/payable dates are distinct. Adjusted close ratios already include vendor adjustments; no additional dividend, split, spin-off or terminal return is added. These are retrospective gross USD proxies, not exact broker dividend reinvestments. No shareholder successor mapping was applied in these windows; limitations and issuer references are in each review.

review.assessment: International Business Machines common stock retained; no in-window split (issuer 1979 next 1997).20 vendor cash dividends. Later 2021 Kyndryl separation is outside horizon and affects retrospective vendor units. No in-window terminal/successor exchange identified; dividend reconstruction relies on vendor adjusted close.
review.limitations: Absence of a terminal event is an issuer-lineage/vendor-history assessment, not a comprehensive independent corporate-actions database. Continuous daily observations do not alone prove that every distribution adjustment is correct.

review.assessment: Historical General Electric conglomerate common stock, not an investment in the later standalone aviation business. Operating-business acquisitions do not automatically exchange GE shareholders’ holdings. No in-window delisting, bankruptcy or terminal successor mapping applied.
